spans.s: věṇṭhě (EI 16; ASLV), same as viṣaya, nirvṛtti, koṭṭam, etc.; an administrative division; also called věṇṭhěya, vaṇṭya, věṭha, věṭa.
věṇṭhěya (EI 16), a sub-division or district; same as věṇṭhě.
veṇḍugol̤, veṇḍukol̤ (SII 12; SITI), Tamil; supplication; petition; fee for the same; also known as veṇḍukol̤-vari.
